description:
Senator Susan Collins helped pass Trump's Big Beautiful Bill, which took a sledgehammer to health care across the country.

Now, pregnant women in Maine are getting stranded without hospitals to give birth in.

We spoke directly with moms affected by this crisis.

Producer: @lucydeanstockton.online
Editor: @niklaak
Videographer: Tim Ouillette
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: We Went to Maine – Where Moms Are Giving Birth In Cars

description:
How do you get money out of politics without overturning Citizens United? Montana has a solution.

The I-194 ballot initiative would stop artificial persons, including corporations, from contributing to campaigns and political parties.

It could change America as we know it.
